title: Receiving Report
description: Receiving Report contract normalized from the DocuBricks Manufacturing library.
yaml:
apiVersion: ladder.dev/v1alpha1
kind: Form
metadata:
  name: docubricks-manufacturing-receiving-report
  title: Receiving Report
  description: Receiving Report contract normalized from the DocuBricks Manufacturing library.
  version: manufacturing_receiving_report_v1
  source:
    system: docubricks
    sourceId: manufacturing/receiving_report
    sourcePath: Schemas/manufacturing/receiving_report
    sourceVersion: manufacturing_receiving_report_v1
    sourceDigest: 79bcc7b4e666edfa86c35c88725d1459a120448d0d804e6012a4b1b21bcfac5d
spec:
  role: completion
  pages:
    - id: main
      title: Receiving Report
      sections:
        - id: dates-and-terms
          title: Dates And Terms
          description: Dates And Terms fields extracted from the document.
          fields:
            - id: receipt-date
              name: receipt_date
              label: Receipt Date
              description: Date goods were received.
              dataType: date
              widget: date
              required: true
        - id: document-details
          title: Document Details
          description: Document Details fields extracted from the document.
          fields:
            - id: receiving-report-number
              name: receiving_report_number
              label: Receiving Report Number
              description: Receiving report or goods receipt number.
              dataType: string
              widget: text
              required: true
            - id: purchase-order-number
              name: purchase_order_number
              label: Purchase Order Number
              description: Related purchase order number.
              dataType: string
              widget: text
              required: true
            - id: packing-slip-number
              name: packing_slip_number
              label: Packing Slip Number
              description: Supplier packing slip number.
              dataType: string
              widget: text
            - id: received-by
              name: received_by
              label: Received By
              description: Receiving employee or function.
              dataType: string
              widget: text
            - id: shortage-or-overage
              name: shortage_or_overage
              label: Shortage Or Overage
              description: Shortage, overage, or mismatch summary.
              dataType: string
              widget: text
            - id: inspection-required
              name: inspection_required
              label: Inspection Required
              description: Whether quality inspection is required.
              dataType: boolean
              widget: checkbox
        - id: line-items
          title: Line Items
          description: Line Items fields extracted from the document.
          fields:
            - id: line-items-received
              name: line_items_received
              label: Line Items Received
              description: Received line items with part, quantity ordered, quantity received, and disposition.
              dataType: array
              widget: textarea
              required: true
              span: 2
        - id: parties
          title: Parties
          description: Parties fields extracted from the document.
          fields:
            - id: supplier-name
              name: supplier_name
              label: Supplier Name
              description: Supplier name.
              dataType: string
              widget: text
              required: true
            - id: carrier-name
              name: carrier_name
              label: Carrier Name
              description: Carrier or freight provider.
              dataType: string
              widget: text
        - id: risk-and-compliance
          title: Risk And Compliance
          description: Risk And Compliance fields extracted from the document.
          fields:
            - id: hold-status
              name: hold_status
              label: Hold Status
              description: Released, on hold, rejected, pending inspection, or other status.
              dataType: string
              widget: text
  validationRules:
    - id: receiving-report-number-present
      severity: error
      description: receiving_report_number is required for Receiving Report extraction.
      rule:
        op: and
        rules:
          - op: present
            field: receiving_report_number
          - op: gt
            left:
              length: receiving_report_number
            right:
              value: 0
      sourceExpression: receiving_report_number IS NOT NULL AND LENGTH(TRIM(receiving_report_number)) > 0
      supported: true
    - id: receipt-date-present
      severity: error
      description: receipt_date is required for Receiving Report extraction.
      rule:
        op: and
        rules:
          - op: present
            field: receipt_date
          - op: gt
            left:
              length: receipt_date
            right:
              value: 0
      sourceExpression: receipt_date IS NOT NULL AND LENGTH(TRIM(receipt_date)) > 0
      supported: true
    - id: purchase-order-number-present
      severity: error
      description: purchase_order_number is required for Receiving Report extraction.
      rule:
        op: and
        rules:
          - op: present
            field: purchase_order_number
          - op: gt
            left:
              length: purchase_order_number
            right:
              value: 0
      sourceExpression: purchase_order_number IS NOT NULL AND LENGTH(TRIM(purchase_order_number)) > 0
      supported: true
    - id: supplier-name-present
      severity: error
      description: supplier_name is required for Receiving Report extraction.
      rule:
        op: and
        rules:
          - op: present
            field: supplier_name
          - op: gt
            left:
              length: supplier_name
            right:
              value: 0
      sourceExpression: supplier_name IS NOT NULL AND LENGTH(TRIM(supplier_name)) > 0
      supported: true
    - id: line-items-received-present
      severity: error
      description: line_items_received is required for Receiving Report extraction.
      rule:
        op: and
        rules:
          - op: present
            field: line_items_received
          - op: gt
            left:
              length: line_items_received
            right:
              value: 0
      sourceExpression: line_items_received IS NOT NULL AND JSON_ARRAY_LENGTH(line_items_received) > 0
      supported: true
  reviewPolicy:
    unsupportedRuleAction: human-review
    defaultConfidenceThreshold: 0.75
    fieldConfidence:
      receiving_report_number:
        minConfidence: 0.9
        reviewOnBreach: true
        failOnBreach: true
        regulatoryRequired: true
        rationale: High-impact field for Receiving Report workflow.
      purchase_order_number:
        minConfidence: 0.9
        reviewOnBreach: true
        failOnBreach: true
        regulatoryRequired: true
        rationale: High-impact field for Receiving Report workflow.
      supplier_name:
        minConfidence: 0.9
        reviewOnBreach: true
        failOnBreach: true
        regulatoryRequired: true
        rationale: High-impact field for Receiving Report workflow.
      line_items_received:
        minConfidence: 0.9
        reviewOnBreach: true
        failOnBreach: true
        regulatoryRequired: true
        rationale: High-impact field for Receiving Report workflow.
      receipt_date:
        minConfidence: 0.9
        reviewOnBreach: true
        failOnBreach: true
        regulatoryRequired: true
        rationale: Required field for Receiving report extraction.
  modelRouting:
    primary: databricks-claude-sonnet
    fallbackChain:
      - databricks-meta-llama-3-70b-instruct
    maxTokens: 6144
    temperature: 0
    timeoutSeconds: 30
    maxRetries: 2
    tierOverrides: {}
    rationale: Receiving Report documents combine manufacturing, quality, supplier, material, and operational
      control context.
  submissionSchema:
    type: object
    properties:
      receiving_report_number:
        type: string
        description: Receiving report or goods receipt number.
      receipt_date:
        type: date
        description: Date goods were received.
        format: date
      purchase_order_number:
        type: string
        description: Related purchase order number.
      supplier_name:
        type: string
        description: Supplier name.
      packing_slip_number:
        type: string
        description: Supplier packing slip number.
      carrier_name:
        type: string
        description: Carrier or freight provider.
      received_by:
        type: string
        description: Receiving employee or function.
      line_items_received:
        type: array
        items:
          type: object
          properties:
            line_items_received_type:
              type: string
              description: Type or class for line_items_received item.
            line_items_received_description:
              type: string
              description: Description for line_items_received item.
            amount:
              type: number
              description: Amount or value when stated.
            date:
              type: date
              description: Relevant item date when stated.
              format: date
            status:
              type: string
              description: Item status or disposition when stated.
        description: Received line items with part, quantity ordered, quantity received, and disposition.
      shortage_or_overage:
        type: string
        description: Shortage, overage, or mismatch summary.
      inspection_required:
        type: boolean
        description: Whether quality inspection is required.
      hold_status:
        type: string
        description: Released, on hold, rejected, pending inspection, or other status.
    required:
      - receiving_report_number
      - receipt_date
      - purchase_order_number
      - supplier_name
      - line_items_received
    additionalProperties: false
    x-ladder-docubricks:
      completenessChecklist:
        - id: required_fields_present
          description: All required fields are present or explicitly null with low confidence when absent.
          fields:
            - receiving_report_number
            - receipt_date
            - purchase_order_number
            - supplier_name
            - line_items_received
        - id: section_coverage_reviewed
          description: Each declared section was reviewed for extractable evidence.
          sections:
            - dates_and_terms
            - document_details
            - line_items
            - parties
            - risk_and_compliance
        - id: nested_lists_normalized
          description: Object array fields use their item_schema for consistent nested extraction.
          fields:
            - line_items_received
